he.rel: own/I Kings/he/Westminster Leningrad Codex (OSHB, mit Morphologie).json

source.method: Word-by-word review by Claude (November 2026); no automatic links

1:1.note: Periphrastic "they were covering him"; "to him" omitted.

1:2.note: "Behold your servants before you" is a plus.

1:9.note: Zoheleth rendered "great"; En-rogel rendered "spring of the fuller".

1:11.note: "The prophet" plus; "saying" and "son of Haggith" omitted.

1:19.note: "Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada" plus.

1:36.note: "God of my lord the king" rendered "your God".

1:38.note: Cherethites/Pelethites rendered "archers and slingers"; Gihon rendered Siloam.

1:47.note: Ketiv/qere assigned; "God" rendered "the LORD your God".

1:51.note: "Fears King Solomon" rendered "fears before you"; "refuge" plus.

2:3.note: "You will succeed" plus at end; "there" omitted.

2:5.note: "Placed blood of war in peace" rendered "reckoned them as in war"; "trampled" plus.

2:7.note: "Drew near to me" rendered "served me in everything".

2:8.note: Benjaminite and Bahurim paraphrased; "God", "to him", "I" pluses.

2:9.note: "Turn his folly on his head" plus.

2:26.note: "Man of death" rendered "liable to death"; "place" plus.

2:28.note: "That Adonijah was killed", "refuge" pluses; Absalom rendered Solomon.

2:29.note: "Behold beside the altar" rendered "took refuge in the horns of the altar".

2:42.note: Plus 'from Jerusalem ... brook Kidron' (cf. v.37); 'hither and thither' and 'to me' omitted; 'I heard' paraphrased 'thus I will do'.

2:44.note: MT 44b continues in Syriac 2:45. Begins with MT 2:44b; "be" plus.

3:11.note: Order of requests rearranged (riches, enemies, long life); "God" rendered LORD.

3:16.note: "To be judged", "Solomon" pluses; "stood before him" omitted.

3:17.note: "Of them" plus; "Oh my lord" rendered "I beg you, my lord".

3:18.note: "On the third day" rendered "after three days".

3:22.note: Demonstrative for the article and la-hwa for lo grouped; copula hu remains plus.

4:6.note: Ahishar spelled Abinashar; "over the house" rendered "chief of the house".

4:7.note: "These" and "and the army" pluses; ketiv/qere assigned.

4:13.note: "Which is in Gilead" omitted; "which have", "gates" pluses.

5:9.note: "Like the sand on the seashore" omitted.

5:14.note: "And he received gifts from all kings of the earth" plus.

5:15.note: "And Hiram sent to Solomon and blessed him" plus.

5:25.note: "Twenty thousand kors of oil" for "twenty kors".

6:12.note: Verbs swapped ('keep my judgments, do my commandments'), mapped by meaning.

6:15.note: Word-for-word; 'its foundations' covers 'floor of the house'.

6:28.note: Proleptic pronoun grouped with its object; 'fine' plus.

7:7.note: "From floor to floor" rendered "from foundations to roof".

7:18.note: Pomegranates rendered 'pillars'; 'he did' not rendered, 'also' plus.

7:25.note: 'Upon them' rendered twice (grouped); men l'el = milma'la.

7:28.note: 'ith l- = lahem; 'and panels between the frames' omitted.

7:29.note: "Wreaths, work of descent" rendered "appearance of beautiful work".

7:30.note: 'Joined to them' plus; 'ith l- = lahem; 'beyond each' omitted; 'wreaths' rendered 'beautiful work'.

7:31.note: "To the capital and upward" and "work of the base" omitted.

7:36.note: Ketiv/qere assigned; "according to the space of each, and wreaths" omitted.

7:45.note: 'Of service' plus; ketiv/qere 'these' omitted; bare et left unassigned.

7:46.note: "In the valley of Jericho by" plus.

7:48.note: 'The king ... for the house of the LORD' plus; bare et left unassigned.

7:49.note: Word-for-word, reordered; bare et left unassigned.

8:1.note: Syriac reads "tribes" for "elders"; "sons of Israel" replaced by plus verb "and they gathered".

8:2.note: "House of Israel" for "every man of Israel"; Ethanim rendered as month of ingathering.

8:3.note: "Tribes" for "elders"; "of the LORD" added to the ark.

8:4.note: Ark rendered by object suffix; plus "to the temple"; "Israel" added after priests; "with them" reads 'otam as 'ittam.

8:7.note: "Holy place" for "place of the ark"; plus "with their wings".

8:9.note: Plus "covenant" as object of "established"; "land of" omitted.

8:21.note: "Place" omitted; "where is the covenant" condensed to "of the covenant".

8:23.note: Plus "and he prayed"; "God" after "like you" missing; plus "in truth" and "with all their soul".

8:26.note: Plus "LORD"; na omitted; ketiv/qere both rendered by singular.

8:30.note: Plus "before you" and "God"; second "and hear" omitted.

8:33.note: "Before the enemy" as "in battle of the enemies"; "house" as "place".

8:37.note: Two plague terms condensed; "in one of their cities" for "in the land of his gates".

8:47.note: "Consider in their heart" for "bring back to their heart".

8:52.note: "Supplication" stated once for both servant and people; "your servants" plural.

8:53.note: "Their fathers" for "our fathers"; "LORD God" for Adonai YHWH.

8:61.note: "His ways" for "his statutes"; plus list "statutes, judgments, laws".

8:63.note: "Which he sacrificed to the LORD" condensed to "before the LORD".

9:9.note: Plus "of the peoples"; "served" moved before "worshipped"; ketiv/qere both rendered.

9:11.note: "As he desired" for "according to all his desire".

9:15.note: Plus "and he built"; Millo moved after the wall.

9:18.note: Tadmor (qere) chosen; "in the land of the wilderness" reordered.

9:21.note: "In the land" omitted; forced labour as "servants paying tribute".

9:25.note: "Altar before the LORD" for "altar which he built to the LORD"; incense explicit.

10:1.note: "And the name of the LORD" for "concerning the name".

10:13.note: "Which she desired and asked"; second "Solomon" omitted.

10:19.note: Plus "he made"; "round head" for "calf head"; "on each side" for "beside the arms".

10:25.note: Gold and silver reversed; plus a further animal term.

11:2.note: "Mingle with" for "go in to"; plus "and held fast".

11:5.note: Plus "and after Chemosh the idol of the Moabites" (cf. v. 7); Milcom as "god".

11:11.note: Plus "my commandments"; "from your hand" for "from upon you".

11:15.note: "When David laid waste Edom" for "when David was in Edom".

11:20.note: "Among the daughters of the sons" for "among the sons".

11:28.note: "That he was a mighty man" for "that he did work".

11:33.note: Singular verbs (Solomon) for MT plurals; plus "and did not keep".

12:3.note: "People of Israel" for "assembly of Israel"; ketiv/qere both rendered; "saying" omitted.

12:6.note: "Before his father" (Solomon omitted); plus "and said to them".

12:12.note: "All Israel" for "all the people"; ketiv/qere both rendered.

12:16.note: "Not have we a portion" declarative; plus "sons of" and "each to his city" for "to his tents".

12:17.note: "In their cities, and Judah made king"; plus "son of Solomon".

12:18.note: Plus "to all Israel"; Adoniram for Adoram.

12:19.note: "House of Israel rebelled against the house of David".

12:22.note: "Word of the LORD" for "word of God"; "his prophet" for "man of God".

12:28.note: "To all Israel" for "to them"; plus "and he said".

12:32.note: Fifteenth day as "at the full moon"; plus "also".

13:2.note: Plus "hear the word of the LORD".

13:3.note: "Which the LORD sent me" for "which the LORD spoke".

13:5.note: "Which was on it" for "from the altar".

13:8.note: Plus "to the house"; "in this place" omitted.

13:16.note: "Come to your house" for "come with you".

13:23.note: "For the prophet of God" for "for the prophet who brought him back"; plus "water".

13:25.note: Plus clause "and the ass standing beside it".

13:29.note: Plus "who dwelt in it"; "lament over him".

13:33.note: "Fill his hand" paraphrased as "offer an offering".

14:5.note: Plus "to you"; MT "and she disguises" rendered "behold disguised".

14:9.note: "Other" omitted before molten gods; plus "and you".

14:10.note: "Burn as vine shoots until the harvest is complete" for "as one burns dung".

14:15.note: "Reed shaken by the wind" for "in the water"; "this" omitted; Asherim as "idols".

14:18.note: Mourning and burial reversed; plus "the Shilonite".

14:31.note: "With his fathers" and mother's name omitted after burial.

15:4.note: Plus "his father"; "establish him in Jerusalem" for "establish Jerusalem".

15:5.note: Plus "his God"; "in the will of Uriah" for "in the matter of Uriah".

15:7.note: Notice of war between Abijam and Jeroboam omitted.

15:13.note: "Because she had made a feast for her idol".

15:15.note: "Holy things of his fathers"; ketiv/qere both rendered.

15:18.note: "King of Judah" for "the king"; Edom for Aram.

15:32.note: Names reversed: "Baasha and Asa king of Judah" for "Baasha king of Israel".

16:2.note: Plus "thus says the LORD"; "the work of their hands" for "their sins".

16:9.note: "Drinking old wine"; "which he built" for "who was over the house".

16:18.note: "Into the fortress (naos) of the king's house".

16:19.note: Ketiv/qere both rendered; plus "son of Nebat".

16:33.note: "Ahab served the idols" for "made the Asherah".

17:1.note: Plus "king", "he", "when"; "dew or rain"; "at my word" rendered "when I say".

17:3.note: "which is before" for "which is on the face of".

17:15.note: Follows Qere order; plus "sons of" and "those".

17:24.note: Minus "the woman to Elijah" and "this"; "prophet" for "man".

18:3.note: "his chief of house" for "who was over the house".

18:4.note: "Prophets of God" for "prophets of the LORD"; distributive "fifty fifty" (plus).

18:8.note: Plus "he; and he said to him".

18:13.note: Active "Did I not show"; plus "I took"; "prophets of God".

18:19.note: "prophets of fear" for Asherah; plus "and fifty" for the Asherah prophets.

18:21.note: Plus "he" twice; "did not give him a word" for "did not answer".

18:24.note: Plus "my God", "that"; "which god" for "the god who".

18:25.note: Minus "call on the name of your god but put no fire" (14-19).

18:27.note: Free rendering with "or perhaps" series; plus "there is".

18:29.note: Large plus: Elijah tells the prophets to stop so he can offer (17-30).

18:44.note: Plus "I saw"; "palm of a hand" for "palm of a man".

18:45.note: "while he turned here and there" for "meanwhile".

19:1.note: Plus "of Baal and of the shrines"; proleptic "them".

19:2.note: Plus "by the hand of", "to me" twice; "I will do it to your soul".

19:4.note: Minus "he came"; plus "one", "to me", "from me", "I was".

19:5.note: Minus "one", "this"; "drew near to him" for "touched him".

19:9.note: "What are you doing" for "what to you".

19:13.note: "there was upon him" for "behold"; "what are you doing".

19:15.note: "Edom" for "Aram"; "that he may reign" for "as king".

19:19.note: "leading a plough and twelve yokes"; "one of the twelve".

19:20.note: "went" for "ran"; plus "to him", "let me go"; minus "please".

20:6.note: Minus "but"; "their eyes" for "your eyes"; plus "and come".

20:16.note: "drinking old wine" for "drunk"; minus "king"; plus "who came".

20:27.note: Plus "kids"; camping merged into "stood against them".

20:28.note: 'Prophet of God' for 'man of God'; first 'said' omitted; plus 'Ahab', 'to him', copula; 'Edomites'.

20:31.note: Plus "drew near"; minus "house"; sackcloth on heads and cords on loins (swapped); "our soul".

20:33.note: Double rendering of 'the men divined' ('the man was a diviner' / 'the men crept'); plus 'Barhadad', 'with him'.

21:7.note: "you will prosper to be king" for "do you now exercise kingship".

21:13.note: Minus "before the people"; "those men" for "men of Belial".

21:15.note: "did not want to sell it to you"; minus first "stoned".

21:19.note: Minus the second "and you shall speak to him saying"; plus "behold".

21:20.note: "you made yourself great" for "you sold yourself".

21:23.note: "in the portion of Jezreel" for "by the rampart of Jezreel"; minus "saying".

22:4.note: Minus "to the king of Israel"; plus "I go".

22:10.note: Plus "speckled"; "at the entrance" for "on the threshing floor at the entrance".

22:22.note: "you will succeed" for "you will be able".

22:27.note: "bread of sustenance"; plus "give him to drink".

22:34.note: "pangs of death reached me" for "I am wounded".

22:44.note: "put spices on the high places" for "burnt incense".
